values.note: Advance reservations required, no drop-ins: online through the district's Rec1 catalog (a free account is needed at booking) or by phone to the park office Mon-Fri 9-5. Reservations only for the current calendar year. Elbert County limits campers to 30 days a calendar year; in summer (May 1 - Oct 31) daily rates only, 30 days a season for RVs; winter 30-day permits on request. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm. Cancellation fee 10%, no refund within 14 days.

note: Elizabeth Park & Recreation District campground in the ponderosa pines of 103-acre Casey Jones Park, 4189 Hwy 86 just east of Elizabeth; the campground entrance is separate from the park's, just east of it off Hwy 86. The park also has ballfields, an equestrian arena with overnight corrals (fee; no livestock in the campground), a dog park and a 1.4-mi trail; Evans Park next door has a fishing pond and trails to Main Street. Camp host near the entrance. No wood or charcoal fires; propane only. --Claude
summary: District page: confirmed 24 RV sites, 50/30-amp + water at all, sewer at 22, showers, dump, year-round, $45-65. Added booking (reservations required via Rec1/phone, fcfs never, 30-night calendar-year cap) and notes. Note cleaned of field restatements.
